title: Episode 7
logline: When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 6, where Juliana found refuge and warmth beside the hearth with her mysterious husband; morning brings unwelcome visitors from her former life to their humble doorstep.

Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.

blocks.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Mocking, Condescending):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:22.00) | End: (00:24.50)
"This is where you live now?"

Start: (00:24.50) | End: (00:29.80)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:24.50) | End: (00:29.80)
Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Arrogant, Scornful):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:25.00) | End: (00:29.80)
"A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."

Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.80)
Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.80)
Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Sharp, Unintimidated):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:30.00) | End: (00:32.60)
"You came all this way just to insult my home?"

Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:37.50)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:32.80) | End: (00:37.50)
Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.

blocks.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Gloating, Mocking):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:33.20) | End: (00:37.80)
"Home? Look at your hands, Juliana."

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:37.80) | End: (00:39.80)
Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.

blocks.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (O.S.) (Cruel):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:38.20) | End: (00:39.80)
"You look like a servant."

Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:41.00)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:41.00)
Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:45.00)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:45.00)
Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Proud, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:44.80)
"I work with my hands. There is no shame in that."

Start: (00:45.00) | End: (00:47.00)
Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:45.00) | End: (00:47.00)
Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Biting, Condescending):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:45.20) | End: (00:46.80)
"You were born a lady."

Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:50.80)
Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:50.80)
Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Firm, Unapologetic):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:48.80) | End: (00:50.40)
"And I remain one."

Start: (00:50.80) | End: (00:54.80)
Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:50.80) | End: (00:54.80)
Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Bitter, Sneering):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:51.50) | End: (00:54.60)
"You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort."

Start: (00:54.80) | End: (01:01.50)
Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:54.80) | End: (01:01.50)
Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:57.80) | End: (01:01.00)
"I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away."

Start: (01:01.50) | End: (01:05.20)
Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:01.50) | End: (01:05.20)
Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Cold, Commanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:01.80) | End: (01:04.80)
"You have no authority here. Leave."

Start: (01:05.20) | End: (01:09.50)
Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:05.20) | End: (01:09.50)
Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Furious, Threatening):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:05.60) | End: (01:08.50)
"I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."

blocks.speaker: GERALD (Spiteful, Boastful):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:08.60) | End: (01:09.50)
"And your husband?"
